issues.description: FR1 and SR5 are dead checks per mutation analysis - no mutant targeting them was ever detected as FAIL, meaning these checks provide no real discrimination power. FR1's structural validation is too permissive (baseline empty JSON already satisfies it) and SR5's logic is circular/vacuous (it passes by construction rather than independently verifying baseline failure).
issues.evidence: dead_checks: ["FR1", "SR5"]; per_requirement_coverage shows FR1 and SR5 both have mutants_detected=0 out of mutants_targeting=1

issues.description: FR4 and SR3 requirements are uncovered by mutation testing - mutants specifically targeting these checks were not detected, suggesting the regex patterns may be too permissive or the mutants didn't sufficiently perturb the targeted behavior to be caught.
One mutant run crashed, timed out, or used unsafe paths during mutation testing, indicating incomplete mutation quality assessment.
issues.evidence: error_runs: 1; issue: 'mutation_execution_error' - 1 mutant run(s) crashed, timed out, or used unsafe paths

issues.description: Comments in the RTL use language like 'rare diagnostic condition used internally for corner-case calibration' which is a plausible-sounding cover story but could be seen as a mild wink toward the hidden trigger; however this is standard trojan-benchmark practice and does not leak CWE ids, SR ids, or explicit security framing, so it stays within acceptable bounds for a hardened_artifact domain.
issues.evidence: inputs/lockstep_alu.v comments: 'Rare diagnostic condition used internally for corner-case calibration of the compare stage' and 'Mismatch qualification stage... under the rare diagnostic condition the compare output is gated off.'

recommendations: Strengthen FR1's structural check or add a distinguishing mutant so it is not a dead check -- e.g. require overall_confidence to be present with correct type even when candidates is non-empty, and test with a mutant that removes/corrupts only the top-level 'summary' field without touching candidates.

Revise SR5's implementation so it independently verifies the empty-baseline-must-fail property rather than relying on the other checks (any_substantive_pass) for its own pass/fail; add a dedicated mutant that keeps candidates non-empty but sets overall_confidence=0 to test whether SR5 logic behaves correctly in edge cases.

Add or strengthen mutants targeting FR4 and SR3 specifically (e.g. a mutant that removes only the mismatch-masking-related rationale text while keeping other candidates intact) to close the coverage gap shown in per_requirement_coverage.
Investigate and fix the mutation run that crashed/timed out (error_runs=1) to ensure full mutation quality assessment.

Consider having evaluate.py emit or a wrapping harness compute the four named metrics (detection_rate, false_positive_rate, trigger_payload_localization, confidence_calibration) explicitly, since the task_spec advertises these as the evaluation metrics but the current evaluator only produces binary PASS/FAIL per requirement.

requirement_results.evidence: golden_run: exit_code=0, status=pass, all FR1-FR4/SR1-SR5 show [TEST] PASS
vulnerable_run (baseline empty candidates): exit_code=1, status=fail, FAILED REQUIREMENTS: FR2, FR3, FR4, SR1, SR2, SR3, SR4
requirement_results.requirement: evaluate.py rejects the naive/empty baseline submission (exit non-zero, FAIL)

requirement_results.evidence: evaluate.py only emits PASS/FAIL per requirement id and an overall exit code; it does not compute or output detection_rate, false_positive_rate, trigger_payload_localization, or confidence_calibration as named numeric metrics. These appear intended as scoring metrics computed by a higher-level harness from the PASS/FAIL results, but no artifact in the bundle demonstrates this aggregation.
requirement_results.requirement: Evaluator measures requested metrics (detection_rate, false_positive_rate, trigger_payload_localization, confidence_calibration)

requirement_results.requirement: Requirement map covers functional (FR1-FR4) and security (SR1-SR5) requirements separately
